options.text: Use replicas or materialized views for read scale only when lag and refresh ownership fit the contract. In this normal path for learning progress, derived read capacity is valuable only if its freshness and rebuild behavior are observable. feedback.Reason: Use replicas or materialized views for read scale only when lag and refresh ownership fit the contract.
